title: 第十八章 旧案终昭雪，恶妇罪难逃
content_zh:
翌日清晨，天光澄澈，丞相府正堂肃静无声。

    往日里迎来送往、笑语不绝的前厅，今日气氛沉得压人。老夫人端坐在紫檀木主位上，面色威严，眉眼间尽是寒色。沈敬山立在一侧，一身常服却身姿紧绷，眼底翻涌着震怒与愧疚。府中几位辈分最高的旁支长辈尽数到场，各院管事垂首立在两侧，无人敢出半声气息。

    今日，专审多年前嫡母旧案。

    凝香院的柳氏与沈轻柔被婆子押至堂中，双双跪在冰冷的青石板上。

    时隔多日，柳氏依旧妆容规整，衣袍整洁，丝毫不见悔过模样。她抬眼时眼底藏着一丝笃定，只要人证各执一词、物证不够闭环，今日这桩旧案便定不了她的罪。

    沈清鸢立在堂下左侧，身姿挺拔，神色平静无波。

    “开审吧。”老夫人沉声开口。

    最先传唤的，是柳氏重金请来翻供的丫鬟春儿。

    春儿跪在地上，面色慌张，眼神飘忽，按着柳氏教好的说辞哆哆嗦嗦开口：“当年……当年主母是自身体弱多病，与柳姨娘无关。柳姨娘待人温柔，从未私下动手害人，是张嬷嬷心怀旧怨，故意捏造证据栽赃……”

    话还没说完，沈清鸢便淡淡开口打断：“你当年在主母院中，负责的是外院洒扫、递送杂物，从未踏入过内寝，更不曾近身伺候汤药，对不对？”

    春儿身子一僵，下意识点头。

    “既然从未近身，”沈清鸢目光锐利，字字清晰，“你何以笃定，无人暗中在汤药里加料？主母每日喝的汤药配方、熬药时辰、贴身伺候之人，你一概不知，你的证词不过是听人转述、凭空臆测，也配做证？”

    一语戳破破绽。

    堂中众人瞬间了然，纷纷看向面色惨白的春儿。

    这番证词，根本站不住脚，纯属无稽之谈。

    春儿彻底慌了神，语无伦次，前后说辞矛盾百出，最后只能瘫在地上，支支吾吾说不出一句完整的话。

    柳氏心头一沉，第一手棋，彻底废了。
content_en:
The next morning, the sky was clear and the main hall of the Prime Minister's Mansion was silent.

In the past, the front hall was filled with greetings and laughter, but today the atmosphere was somber and oppressive.The old lady was sitting on the rosewood chair with a majestic look on her face and a cold look between her brows and eyes.Shen Jingshan stood on one side, dressed in regular clothes but with a tight posture, and anger and guilt welling up in his eyes.Several of the most senior branch elders in the mansion were all present. The stewards of each hospital stood on both sides with their heads bowed, and no one dared to breathe a word.

Today, we are specializing in the trial of an old case of my aunt from many years ago.

Mrs. Liu and Shen Qingrou from Ningxiang Courtyard were escorted into the hall by their mother-in-law, and they both knelt on the cold bluestone.

After many days, Ms. Liu still wore neat makeup and neat clothes, showing no sign of regret.When she raised her eyes, there was a hint of certainty in her eyes. As long as the witnesses held different opinions and the physical evidence was not enough to close the loop, today's old case would not be able to convict her.

Shen Qingyuan stood on the left side of the hall, tall and straight, with a calm expression.

"Let the trial begin." The old lady said in a deep voice.

The first person to be summoned was Chun'er, the maid whom Liu paid a lot of money to retract her confession.

Chun'er knelt on the ground, her face panicked, her eyes wandering, and she spoke tremblingly according to the words taught by Mrs. Liu: "Back then... the mistress was weak and sick, and it had nothing to do with Aunt Liu. Aunt Liu was gentle to others and never harmed anyone in private. It was Aunt Zhang who had nostalgic resentment and deliberately fabricated evidence to frame her..."

Before she finished speaking, Shen Qingyuan interrupted calmly: "When you were in the main courtyard, you were responsible for sweeping the outer courtyard and delivering sundries. You never stepped into the inner bedroom, let alone served the soup, right?"

Chuner stiffened and nodded subconsciously.

"Since you have never been close," Shen Qingyuan's eyes were sharp and his words were clear, "How can you be sure that no one secretly added ingredients to the soup? You don't know anything about the formula of the soup that the mistress drinks every day, the time when the medicine is boiled, or the people who serve her personally. Your testimony is just a narration and a conjecture, and you are not qualified to testify?"

One word to expose the flaw.

Everyone in the hall understood instantly and looked at Chun'er who looked pale.

This testimony is completely untenable and is pure nonsense.

Chun'er was completely panicked, her words were incoherent, and her words were full of contradictions. In the end, she could only collapse on the ground, hesitating and unable to say a complete sentence.

Liu's heart sank, her first move was completely useless.
